admin_pages.label: Settings
admin_pages.help: Test Pay takes no real money. Any secret will do; it signs the test processor's webhooks.

fields.label: Signing secret
fields.help: A real gateway puts its processor's webhook signing secret here.

fields.label: Settle refunds by webhook
fields.help: Off: a refund is settled on the spot. On: it stays pending until the processor's webhook says how it ended.
